email.subject: POAP KINGS | A Clash Royale Clan With Proof
email.body:
Hi there,

We wanted to share an invitation to join a great Clash Royale clan: POAP KINGS.

POAP KINGS is built around active, positive gameplay and something a little different—collecting POAPs as proof of participation and shared clan history. With 18 members and 132,730 combined trophies, it's a growing community for players who enjoy progression, competition, and being part of something.

POAP KINGS | A Clan With Proof
Clan Tag: #J2RGCRVG
Region: United States
League: Bronze (and climbing)
Members: 18
Combined Trophies: 132,730
Weekly Donations: 212
Avg Member Level: 42.5
Required Trophies: 2,000

What makes POAP KINGS different
- Clan members collect unique POAPs tied to milestones and participation
- War winners are awarded Free Pass Royale
- Elders donate regularly to support the clan
- War participation is encouraged, but not required
- Active members expected; inactive accounts are removed to keep the clan healthy

Early active members will receive a POAP KINGS Founder token, marking them as part of the clan from the start.

If this sounds like a good fit, here's how to learn more or join:

🌎 Learn more: https://poapkings.com
🔗 Join the clan: https://link.clashroyale.com/invite/clan/en?tag=J2RGCRVG&token=dtw94pzg

Hope to see you in the arena.
